title: 내모남불 ① 자동차편 · 끼어들기 · 깜빡이 · 주차

lines.en: Seriously? Cutting in without a signal?
That's illegal! Illegal!
Dad, you didn't signal just now either.
I'm fine. So what~

lines.text: 내가 하면 모 어때, 남이 하면 불법. 내모남불, 하나.
lines.en: When I do it, so what. When you do it, illegal. Double standard, number one.
I'm… Modapman.

lines.text: 사건 개요. 토요일 오전, 목적지 마트.
lines.en: Case summary. Saturday morning. Destination: the supermarket.
Drive nicely today.
Who follows the law better than me?
Plenty of people.

lines.tts: 딱 세 판만 하죠. 일 라운드, 끼어들기.
lines.en: Just three rounds. Round one: cutting in.

lines.text: 저 봐! 맨 앞에서 쓱 끼잖아!
lines.en: Look! He just slid in at the very front!
Apologize to everyone in line! Apologize!
Five minutes later.
…Honey, where are you going?

lines.text: 이건 새치기 아니고, 살짝 들어간 거야.
lines.en: This isn't cutting. I just eased in a little.
Double standard, number two.
Sir, a little is still cutting in.

lines.text: 줄 선 차들 사이로 들어오시면 안 돼요.
lines.en: You can't squeeze in between cars waiting in line.

lines.tts: 범칙금 삼만 원, 벌점 십 점입니다.
lines.en: That's a 30,000 won fine and 10 penalty points.
…Huh?

lines.tts: 이 라운드, 깜빡이. 마침 집중단속 기간.
lines.en: Round two: turn signals. Right in the middle of a crackdown.
Moragu, a turn signal is a conversation.
It says, 'I'm coming in~'

lines.text: 그럼 아까 아빠는 무슨 말 했어?
lines.en: Then what did you say back there?
I… signaled in my heart.
Double standard, number three.
Your heart doesn't show up on camera.

lines.tts: 차로 바꾸기 삼십 미터 전부터 켜세요.
lines.en: Turn it on 30 meters before you change lanes.
Honey, even the model answer can't save you here.

lines.tts: 삼 라운드, 주차. 장소, 마트 앞.
lines.en: Round three: parking. Location: in front of the supermarket.

lines.text: 소화전 앞에 차를 대? 당장 신고해!
lines.en: Parked in front of a fire hydrant? Report him right now!
Why can't you park there?

lines.text: 불 나면 소방차가 물 받는 데니까.
lines.en: Because that's where fire trucks get water when there's a fire.
Three minutes later. The parking lot is full.
Just one minute. So what~
Double standard, number four.
…We meet again.
I do grocery shopping too.

lines.tts: 소화전 오 미터 안은 주차 금지예요.
lines.en: No parking within 5 meters of a fire hydrant.

lines.tts: 신고 사진은 일 분 간격으로 두 장.
lines.en: A report takes two photos, one minute apart.
So one minute is plenty. For the report.
…Huh?
Dad, the line, the signal, the hydrant…
They're all for other people.
…You're right. In a fire, every second counts.
Then don't say 'so what.' Say 'what about them?'
Think first about how others will feel?
Yeah. That's what a conversation is.
On the way home.
Okay, from now on I always signal!
Two kilometers later.
Honey, your signal is still on.
Dad, this time you left it on too long.
That's not a double standard. Just a wrong answer.
…Modapman, as always.
